actions: Resolved the historical mnemo PR #96 CI failure class without using hosted compute: old workspace Build/Test/Clippy failure is attributable to the WASM mnemo-golem-wit crate being included in native workspace jobs; current CI explicitly excludes that crate for native linking. Historical raw logs are expired, and Security Audit remains separate/unresolved.

Performed an exact-tree and verifier audit of the retrospective Memory-Collapse-Eval ScienceWorld package, including task manifest, stream/pool objects, checkpoint memory snapshots, 1500 per-task rows, packed eval trajectories, source/config and GitHub CPU CI.

Audited ScienceWorld denominator semantics: published success rates use 50 total tasks while arms.csv also records n_valid after non-outcome filtering; verify_numbers.py checks success count but not displayed rate/denominator.

Audited verifier coverage closure and found that the public claim of 675 reproduced cells is mapper-defined rather than an independent inventory of every publication numeric/data cell. ScienceWorld baseline_gpt_20fam.csv is absent from CHECKS; trend z/p/slope fields and eval task-count/rate/raw/full/negative-score fields are unmapped; raw_k16 yields no sciworld_eval check.
Created p1-protocol-067 PUBLISHED_TABLE_VERIFIER_COVERAGE_CLOSURE_GATE to fail closed on silent table/cell omissions, denominator drift and mapper-count-only coverage claims.

Explored the ARC stream self-eval package as a cleaner deterministic outcome surface. Bound the 8.64MB plain per-task row blob, frozen memory snapshots, exact grader/sandbox source and immutable gzip trajectory blobs. Confirmed grader semantics: generated solve code runs on all shown+held-out examples and each IO passes by exact got == expected equality.

Tested scheduled-Chat transport of ARC grade trajectories. Directory/blob identities are visible, but direct read of the gzip/non-UTF8 trajectory payload is rejected by the current text repository route. Therefore aggregate static replay from plain JSONL is possible, but row-level got/expected verification is not accepted without unpacked UTF-8 grade ledger or a different execution path.

findings.summary: mnemo PR #96 historical Build/Test/Clippy red status is attributable to an unrelated native-workspace link defect involving mnemo-golem-wit; it is no longer evidence against the Auto-Dreamer-style benchmark itself. Historical logs are expired and Security Audit remains a separate unresolved check.

mnemo still lacks the exact generated UUID/timestamp inputs, ordered receiver outputs and same-path audit-event transcript required by p1-protocol-066, so full static benchmark replay remains rejected; do not revisit absent public-surface change.

Memory-Collapse-Eval is the strongest retrospective static evidence package located in this branch: one immutable Git root co-locates frozen tasks, ScienceWorld stream/pools, method memory snapshots, per-task outcomes, packed eval trajectories, source/config and a public aggregate verifier.

ScienceWorld binds an explicit 50-task held-out manifest (blob 0ea6fea6...), stream_v9 (0049292c...), method snapshots, 1500 per-task rows (7ab4b9dd...), eval trajectory archive (18b835f0...) and simulator/config. Missing build-step trace, server logs, Letta DB dumps and provider-side execution identity prevent full construction replay.

ScienceWorld has two denominator surfaces: publication tables report success/50 while per-arm data also records n_valid after dropping error/skipped rows. verify_numbers.py drops non-outcomes but verifies only success counts, so green arithmetic CI does not attest the displayed rate denominator.

The '675 cells, 0 mismatched' verifier result is coverage-incomplete for ScienceWorld: a whole baseline CSV and multiple numeric columns/rows are unmapped, and the test asserts only verifier success/zero mismatch rather than independent publication-cell coverage closure.

Two GitHub-hosted CPU gates independently attest the 675 mapper-defined checks at the retrospective release revision; the separate AgentGym plugin failure does not negate those checks. This is verifier-run attestation, not original hosted-model run attestation.

The Memory-Collapse-Eval repository is a retrospective public audit package relative to the May 13 paper. Its Git object identity strongly binds released bytes but cannot by itself provide original execution-time nonrepudiation or provider-side run identity.

ARC stream self-eval provides a plain 8.64MB per-task row ledger plus exact frozen memory snapshots and immutable packed trajectory blobs; its grader is deterministic after a candidate is fixed, with task success requiring all shown+held-out examples and each IO correctness defined as got == expected.

ARC aggregate outcomes can be statically reduced from plain committed rows, but full row-level outcome verification is not scheduled-Chat-native on the tested route because got/expected grade transcripts are packed as gzip/non-UTF8 blobs rejected by the text connector. Publishing an unpacked UTF-8 grade ledger would close this transport child without model execution.

exact_next_action: Rebind DESIRED_STATE and scientist_agents config, then resume from this checkpoint.
